# Panel 257's blind seat: the blinding key, published after the scoring

Published 2026-11-23 by the session that scored the blind seat, after every graded session had been written down by its
folder's letter (`llm-ergonomist-blind.md` § How it was run; `outcomes-by-letter.txt` in the archive). The key below is the
`key.txt` the run's `tools/make_sessions.py` wrote beside `s/`, never inside a session's folder, reproduced byte for byte:
its first line names the label each arm was drawn, and each row a folder, its arm and the sha256 of each file the session
was handed. The draw was made at preparation, **by `secrets.SystemRandom`** (the key's second line; OS entropy, no seed, not
reproducible), before any session ran, and the same bytes stand in `llm-ergonomist-blind-answers.tar.xz`
(`257-llm-ergonomist/key.txt`); the order the sessions ran in is `order.txt`, reproduced after the key.

The three labels are **`now`=`x`, `adopted`=`j`, `rival`=`b`**: five sessions in each of the six cells (`t1-x-*`, `t1-j-*`,
`t1-b-*`, `t2-x-*`, `t2-j-*`, `t2-b-*`), and the verdict's folder, built after the 30. Every `spec.md` hash below is one of
the three the registration names (`docs/panel/257-briefs/blind/registration.md`: `arms/spec-now.md` `15804f3fb52a62c2...`,
`arms/spec-adopted.md` `387cd9da261948700...`, `arms/spec-rival.md` `e809ed7491dccdaa...`), the `adopted` arm being the
frozen spec with the resolution's sentence (R1, `257-reports/spec-sentence.diff`) and the `rival` the frozen spec with
`257-reports/spec-x1.diff`, the positive clause. The verdict's `spec-A.md` is `now` (`15804f3f...`) and its `spec-B.md` is
`adopted` (`387cd9da...`). The verdict's row lists the files it was handed when the key was drawn; **its `reports/` folder,
the 30 reports named by folder and no arm, was built after the 30 sessions** (`run.log`: *"verdict/ built: 43 files, 30 of 30
reports"*) and is not in the row.
